description: List the next N executions of a cron expression with exact timestamps — from now or from any reference datetime. Complements cron-describe (which explains what an expression means) with the concrete schedule agents need when scheduling their own work. Use this when an agent needs to exact upcoming executions for a cron expression. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_cron_next_runs
title: Cron Next Runs
